exposure: Pictorial education program about the labour process
outcome: Intention to do normal vaginal delivery
cohort: The study included 76 pregnant women in their third trimester of pregnancy from four urban healthcare centers in Pars-Abad city, Iran.
finding: The pictorial education program significantly improved knowledge, attitudes, self-efficacy, and behavioral intention for normal vaginal delivery in the intervention group.
mod_finding: 27.06% of women in the intervention group reported normal vaginal delivery versus the control group, and a reduction in cesarean section rates was evident.
